parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) reflects the natural shape of XCTest-style test methods that exercise related but distinct scenarios — `returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` and `invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` — rather than accidental duplication of production logic. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the distinct intent of each test case and couple unrelated failure modes. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every record in the cluster dominates any action signal.
